items.why: The WhatsApp per-conversation → per-message change is already recorded as intercom-2026w44; the rest is a page redesign (Fin priced as a separate line, relabelled add-ons, new cost estimator) with no price change.
The FAQ sentence stating Business-plan overage pricing was removed and a vague ‘Overage fees: Capped / Custom’ comparison row added; no plan price changed, the rest is spelling and counter edits.

Several ‘Unlimited’ labels were dropped or reworded (file uploads, page history, guests, charts, published pages) but the page gives no new numeric caps and the 5 GB per-file limit was already described, so no change can be confirmed.

record.short: Pro now lists higher monthly options of $215, $425, $825 and $2,000 next to the $90 entry with $100 credits.
record.headline: Replit’s Pro plan card now shows a ladder of larger monthly price points, up to $2,000 / month, alongside the $90 / month option with $100 credits.
record.who: Pro customers who need more credits than the entry Pro option; the entry $90 price is unchanged.
record.read: Replit appears to be adding scalable credit tiers inside Pro, so heavy agent users can buy more capacity without going to Enterprise. This is our inference from the price ladder alone.
record.caveat: The page shows the price points but not the credits or allowances attached to the higher options.
